companies.name: Reliance Industries Limited
companies.hook: India's largest company is really four businesses in one share — an oil-to-chemicals giant, the country's biggest telecom and biggest retailer, and a clean-energy-plus-AI moonshot — now pivoting from energy to consumer as the Jio IPO looms.

companies.name: HDFC Bank Limited
companies.hook: India's largest private bank is mid-way through digesting the historic HDFC Ltd mega-merger — refilling deposits to normalise a stretched loan-to-deposit ratio while holding bad loans near 1%.

companies.name: Bharti Airtel Limited
companies.hook: India's premium telco turned cash machine: the highest-ARPU operator in a healed three-player market, deleveraging fast as 5G capex rolls off, with Airtel Africa as a high-growth second engine.

companies.name: ICICI Bank Limited
companies.hook: The poster child of India's 2018 bad-loan crisis rebuilt itself into a best-in-class ~2% ROA compounder with a clean book and four valuable listed subsidiaries.

companies.name: State Bank of India
companies.hook: India's largest bank: an unmatched sovereign-backed deposit franchise, a balance sheet cleaned from a ~10.9% bad-loan crisis to ~1.5%, and listed subsidiaries that partly cover its own market cap — all at a permanent government-ownership discount.

companies.name: Tata Consultancy Services
companies.hook: India's most profitable IT major is a debt-free cash machine that just logged its first-ever dollar-revenue decline — and bets its linear people-by-the-hour model can ride the AI wave instead of being drowned by it.

companies.name: Bajaj Finance Limited
companies.hook: India's largest and most valuable NBFC, where a zero-cost EMI on a new TV is really the cheapest way to acquire a customer it will cross-sell for a decade — which is why a lender growing AUM 22% with sub-1% bad loans still trades at ~5x book.

companies.name: Larsen & Toubro Limited
companies.hook: India's largest engineering & construction conglomerate, riding a record ₹7.4-lakh-crore order book and a national capex supercycle — from refineries and metros to defence, chips and the Gulf.

companies.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
companies.hook: India's state-owned insurance colossus writes more than half of every life-insurance rupee and is the market's single biggest investor — yet trades below its own embedded value.

companies.name: Hindustan Unilever Limited
companies.hook: India's largest FMCG company is a fortress of nine million shops and fifty trusted brands — where underlying volume growth, not headline sales, is the only scorecard that matters.

companies.name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited
companies.hook: India's largest drugmaker is racing from commodity generics into high-margin branded specialty — while a live USFDA import alert and a record $11.75bn Organon takeover reshape the whole story.

companies.name: Adani Power Limited
companies.hook: India's largest private coal-fired generator is betting ₹2 lakh crore on more than doubling its fleet to ~42 GW — a contracted-cash-flow annuity wrapped around an aggressive, debt-funded coal build-out.

companies.name: Maruti Suzuki India Limited
companies.hook: India's car-market king sells two of every five new cars, yet its small-car empire has stalled at a 13-year-low ~39% share — so it is racing into SUVs, record exports and a contrarian CNG-and-hybrid-first powertrain bet to keep growing.
tags: Small-car slowdown vs the SUV pivot

companies.name: Axis Bank Limited
companies.hook: India's clean-booked third private bank, trading ~30% below HDFC and ICICI on a single stubborn weakness: the cost of its deposits.

companies.name: Infosys Limited
companies.hook: India's #2 IT major just crossed $20bn in revenue — but the number the market really trades is its forward guidance, now a referendum on whether generative AI deflates the people-by-the-hour model or wins it share.

companies.name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited
companies.hook: India's largest private port operator — handling ~27% of the nation's cargo and the first Indian operator past 500 MMT in a year — is re-casting itself from a ports company into an integrated shore-to-door transport utility, under the shadow of an Adani-group governance discount.

companies.name: Adani Enterprises Limited
companies.hook: The Adani Group's flagship is less an operating company than an incubator for heavy infrastructure — hatching airports, green energy, copper and data centres, funding them with a coal-trading cash engine, and demerging them one by one as the next Adani Ports or Adani Green.

companies.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited
companies.hook: India's fourth-largest private bank is its most conservative — the sector's best margin and a fortress 21%+ capital ratio that actually holds its returns down — now navigating three CEO transitions in three years since founder Uday Kotak stepped aside.

companies.name: Titan Company Limited
companies.hook: The Tata group's watch-maker became India's most valuable jeweller by selling trust, not gold — riding the shift from family goldsmiths to branded chains, and just compounding profit 52% on a gold-price surge, all at a ~70x earnings multiple.

companies.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited
companies.hook: The only company that makes India's best-selling SUVs and the world's best-selling tractors — a two-engine cash machine re-rated by a ruthless '18% ROE or exit' discipline, now self-funding an ₹80,000-crore electric-SUV bet from a net-cash core.

companies.name: ITC Limited
companies.hook: India's most profitable consumer company is a cigarette cash machine in a consumer-goods coat — funnelling a ferociously-taxed tobacco monopoly's cash into Aashirvaad atta and Sunfeast biscuits, trading cheap with a ~5% yield under a permanent ESG-and-tax cloud.
